title: BC Payment Portfolios
content_data:
Business Center is a one-stop business hub for organizations of all sizes to activate marketing activities and reach desired audiences in a collaborative way on TikTok. Payment Portfolio is a one stop workspace that allows you to view and and manage your options for making payments, including credit lines, cash balance, ad credit, and payment methods, in a unified manner across TikTok for Business platforms. To learn more about Payment Portfolio, see [About Payment Portfolio](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-payment-portfolio). > **Note**
> You can only use BC Payment Portfolios API when you have enabled the multiple Payment Portfolios feature. Multiple Payment Portfolios for one client is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. BC Payment Portfolios API enables you to: - Retrieve existing Payment Portfolios - Create a new Payment Portfolio - Link ad accounts to a Payment Portfolio or retrieve linked ad accounts - Allocate the credit line to Payment Portfolios - Retrieve authorized users who have access to a Payment Portfolio This group consists of the following endpoints: - [Get Payment Portfolios](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839151931301954) - [Create a Payment Portfolio](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839151986039809) - [Link ad accounts to a Payment Portfolio](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839151992566081) - [Allocate the credit line to Payment Portfolios](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839151998450754) - [Get ad accounts linked to a Payment Portfolio](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839152005599234) - [Get authorized users for a Payment Portfolio](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1839152031645121)
